title: Agentic Data Engineering for LLMs: System Design and a Controlled Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.14238v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM data engineering requires iterative experimentation to determine how data selection, rewards, and curricula affect model learning, making it a natural setting for AI-for-AI (AI4AI) research. Can agents use experimental feedback to progressively improve strategies, and do the resulting strategies improve target-model performance on held-out data? We study how agents use experimental feedback to develop data-engineering strategies under fixed training and evaluation protocols. Our Agentic Data Engineering (ADE) framework lets agents pursue, revise, or combine research directions using cumulative findings. Strategies are selected by in-loop scores and evaluated on held-out benchmarks. Across four tasks-math and code data selection, math reward design, and math curriculum learning-selected strategies achieve absolute gains over generic baselines of up to 13.34% on AIME25 Pass@32 and 5.85% averaged across four held-out benchmarks under

translated_title: 面向大语言模型的智能体数据工程：系统设计与受控实证研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）数据工程需要通过迭代实验来确定数据选择、奖励和课程如何影响模型学习，这使其成为“AI服务AI”（AI4AI）研究的天然场景。智能体能否利用实验反馈逐步改进策略？由此产生的策略能否提升目标模型在留出数据上的性能？我们研究了在固定的训练和评估协议下，智能体如何利用实验反馈来开发数据工程策略。我们的智能体数据工程（ADE）框架允许智能体基于累积的研究成果去探索、修改或组合研究方向。策略通过循环内评分进行选择，并在留出基准上进行评估。在四项任务——数学与代码数据选择、数学奖励设计以及数学课程学习——中，被选中的策略相比通用基线取得了显著的绝对提升：在AIME25 Pass@32上最高提升13.34%，在四个留出基准上平均提升5.85%。
tldr: 该论文提出智能体数据工程（ADE）框架，让智能体利用累积实验反馈迭代开发数据工程策略，在数学与代码数据选择、奖励设计和课程学习四项任务上使目标模型性能最高提升13.34%（AIME25 Pass@32）。
